description: This source file defines functions for configuring CLI11 command-line interface options for a 5G NR DU low-layer configuration schema, including logging, tracing, expert PHY settings, execution, hardware acceleration, and metrics. It also provides functions for auto-deriving parameter defaults based on duplex mode.
